sources.label: Original X record for parameter disclosure

patch.notes: Jointly trained by xAI (SpaceXAI) and Cursor. The 1,500B total is the founder’s nominal 1.5T model size, explicitly identified as Grok 4.5 after release; active parameters and expert configuration are undisclosed. Cursor identifies the architecture as MoE. Public API/Cursor release was July 8, 2026; June 28 was private beta and July 17 added EU API availability. Native API context is 500,000 tokens; Cursor documents a separate 256k product limit.

summary: Fresh parameter review preserves the founder-published nominal 1,500B total. Active parameters remain undisclosed after checking named V9/4.6 base continuity, later model cards, Cursor training-kernel research and an exact Grok 4.5 research comparison. All twelve other field assessments are preserved.

parameter_reaudit.outcome: Retain parameters_b=1500 verified (published nominal total); explicitly set active_parameters_b=null undisclosed after separate fresh review.
parameter_reaudit.total_assessment: Both founder payloads were independently refetched and read with author/time and embedded-parent context. The post-release 1.5T aka Grok 4.5 identification directly supports a nominal 1500B total. The earlier named V9 foundation and supplemental Cursor training corroborate it. The prospective 2T model in the same July reply is a separate model. No exact host/tensor attestation is required to retain the nominal size.
parameter_reaudit.active_assessment: No original source checked supplies a separately reported active count, expert configuration or applicable measured active convention. Do not turn 1.5T total into active, derive a count from MoE, or use parameter counts from Composer/open-weight kernel tests or the Tev base model.
parameter_reaudit.lineage_assessment: June founder post names the 1.5T V9 foundation and supplemental Cursor training; the own card describes midtraining, SFT and RL without a disclosed structural size change. Cursor explicitly identifies Grok 4.6 as the same base as Grok 4.5; its card places that family at 1.5T scale. These named relationships corroborate the already direct total but provide no active size to inherit. The 4.7 card’s teacher-generated trajectories are not unchanged architecture evidence and are not transferred.
parameter_reaudit.later_comparison_assessment: Searched the complete original 29/42/30-page Grok 4.5/4.6/4.7 cards, with special attention to exact Grok 4.5 rows and development sections. The later tables report performance/safety, not active parameters. The fresh Tev model card also compares exact Grok 4.5 using four pass-rate columns, with no parameter column. Its own 320B/18B specification belongs to another named model. No supported nominal active-count convention was found.
parameter_reaudit.search_findings: Bounded fresh searches separately covered total, active/activated, later original research tables and named base/structural-change relationships. Search results included secondary 1.5T repetitions and claims that all size information is unreported; neither overrides the direct founder disclosure. Other hits were API request parameters rather than weight counts. No unsupported directory estimate was adopted.
parameter_reaudit.access_limitations: All seven independent direct fetches returned HTTP 200 and are recorded in /tmp/parameter-532-reaudit/manifest.json. The 4.6 PDF was also reopened through web retrieval. The complete 4.5 and 4.7 card texts and xAI launch were independently read from the parent’s documented October 27 HTTP 200 caches; they are not claimed as independent agent refetches. The June founder long post is truncated after its intact size-and-lineage statement.
